title: infra-ontology edge, v1
description: One row of edges.parquet, in its JSON Lines form: a typed link between two nodes. The edge reads from refers to, or depends on, to. So what breaks if X changes follows edges backwards from X.

edge_id.description: The hex SHA-256 of the kind, from_id and to_id.

from_id.description: The node_id the edge starts at.

to_id.description: The node_id the edge points to.

kind.description: The edge kind. v0 writes depends_on, contained_in, defined_in and reads_state_of, and format minor 2 adds can_assume (a principal to a role its trust policy names); later minor versions may add kinds, so readers accept an unknown one.

confidence.description: How the edge was learned: observed in a source, computed from read data, or inferred.

basis.description: A short code for why the edge exists, for example state_dependency, module_containment, remote_state, catalogue_child or resource_path, and for can_assume trust_policy, trust_policy_cross_account, trust_policy_account, trust_policy_condition, trust_policy_deny or trust_policy_wildcard. Open to additions in a minor version.

source_id.description: The source the edge came from (a source_id in sources.parquet).
